name: Panora
tagline: Ghost kitchens for brands too big to fry their own fries.
positioning: Panora runs the invisible kitchen layer behind enterprise food brands — one platform for delivery-only locations, virtual concepts, and the mess in between.

hero.h1: Your food brand. Somebody else's stove.
hero.sub: Panora is the operations layer for delivery-only kitchens. Spin up virtual concepts, route orders across shared facilities, and pay for the burners you actually use.

features.title: Concepts on demand
features.description: Launch a virtual brand across 40 markets in a weekend, not a fiscal quarter. Menus, packaging, and POS wiring configured before your VP notices.

features.title: One order graph
features.description: Every delivery order from every marketplace lands in a single ticket rail. No more nine tablets screaming at one poor line cook.

features.title: Facility utilization
features.description: See exactly which stations are idle at 2pm Tuesday and which are underwater on Friday, per location, per concept, live.

features.title: Throughput SLAs
features.description: Enforce prep-time and error-rate targets across contracted kitchens, with penalties that actually show up on the invoice.

features.title: Menu versioning
features.description: Roll out a price change or 86 an item everywhere at once, and roll it back when legal calls. Full audit trail included.

features.title: Compliance you can hand off
features.description: Food-safety logs, temperature checks, and franchise standards captured per shift and exported the way auditors like them.

testimonials.quote: We were running eleven virtual brands out of one commissary and reconciling it in a spreadsheet named final_FINAL_v6. Panora made that spreadsheet a war crime we no longer commit.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: The utilization dashboard paid for itself in a quarter. We killed three dead concepts and doubled down on the two printing money. No more guessing which stove is lying to us.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Onboarding a new delivery market used to take our team six weeks and a therapist. Now it's a Tuesday afternoon and a fresh QR code.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

pricing.blurb: For operators testing one or two concepts across a handful of kitchens.
For multi-market groups juggling concepts, marketplaces, and SLAs.
For enterprise brands and franchisors running dozens of facilities.

homepage.footerBlurb: Panora is the operations layer for delivery-only kitchens. We handle the invisible part so your brand can pretend it has a dining room.
